newsitem.title: CHINA: China to offer 40 bln yuan in domestic debt.
newsitem.headline: China to offer 40 bln yuan in domestic debt.

text.p: China plans to issue 40.0 billion yuan ($4.8 billion) of three-year domestic debt beginning next month, Finance Ministry officials said on Tuesday.
The debt will carry annual interest of 9.18 percent and will be listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges, they told Reuters.
The offering will be aimed at individual investors, the officials said.
No decision had been made yet on the formation of an underwriting group for the debt, the officials said.
China has been trying to use both long and short-term debt offers to enhance its domestic financial system as well as raise much needed cash to fund government operations.
It plans to issue 248.596 billion yuan of domestic and foreign debt this year, up 27.3 percent from last year.
It also plans to cut its budget deficit by 7.2 percent to 57.0 billion yuan this year from 61.442 billion yuan last year.
